login_mfa_intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login_mfa_recovery_intro: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
password_intro: Changing your password signs out your other devices.
password_set_intro: This account has no password yet. You need one to turn login on.
password_changed: Password saved. Your other devices were signed out.
totp_off_intro: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after your password.
totp_on_intro: Two-step login is on. You need a code from your authenticator app each time you sign in.
totp_enroll_intro: Scan this code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp_qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp_secret_label: Cannot scan? Enter this key in the app instead:
totp_recovery_intro: If you lose your authenticator, each code signs you in once. They are shown only now.
totp_disable_intro_password: Enter your password to turn it off.
totp_disable_intro_code: Enter a code from your authenticator app to turn it off.
recovery_file_note: Each code works once in place of an authenticator code. Keep this file somewhere safe.
sessions_intro: Sign out any device you no longer use.
